text:
elaine: Quick sync — SI launch orchestration for marketplace next week. Need final signoffs: press timeline, co-branded landing, SI enablement docs. Who can confirm assets?
omar: I can own SI enablement docs. ETA EOD Tue. Will post doc link when ready.
jenna_pm: Press timeline — press embargo window is Tue morning PT, internal review Mon. @mike_sales please confirm quotes.
mike_sales: Confirmed. I’ll draft partner quote by Mon 2pm.
cloudpartner-eng: We need final container image (v1.3) and quickstart snippet. Can ops push image by Monday?
devops-bot: image build succeeded: registry.redwood.com/si/quickstart:v1.3 :white_check_mark:
omar: I'll add quickstart snippet to enablement doc:
```
docker run --rm registry.redwood.com/si/quickstart:v1.3 --license XYZ
```
jenna_pm: Landing page — design wants final hero copy + logo files by Tue 10am PT. @design-ops?
design-ops: On it. Sharing initial hero copy in #design in 30m. Need SI logos in SVG. @cloudpartner-eng can you confirm logo files?
cloudpartner-eng: Dropping SVGs in shared drive now: https://drive.example.com/si/logos (internal)
elaine: Great — can we lock the announcement time? Proposed: Wed 14:00 UTC. That gives APAC visibility and NA morning. Thoughts?
mike_sales: Wed 14:00 UTC +1 week for marketplace listing? or same day? we prefer same day listing in marketplace.
jenna_pm: Prefer same day listing. We need marketplace metadata by Tue EOD. @partners-ops can you complete the marketplace form?
partners-ops: Taking marketplace metadata — will fill and upload assets by Tue 6pm PT.
elaine: Blockers?
security: Quick note — ensure SSO and SCIM notes are in enablement doc and landing privacy blurb has contact. I'll review.
omar: Added SSO/SCIM section. Ready for security review now.
elaine: Awesome. I'll run a final preflight doc & checklist tomorrow 9am PT. If nothing else, we'll move forward with Wed 14:00 UTC announce. :rocket:
devops-bot: reminder: schedule runbook rehearsal Tue 16:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.
jenna_pm: Thanks all — small follow-ups in threads. Let's keep channel updates short. :thumbsup:
